text: WEB v0.717's stance model is an explicit reach-vs-damage inversion, and both halves use the same mastery coefficients. REACH: Light base x1.4, Balanced base x(1 + 0.02*mastery), Heavy base x(0.5 + 0.04*mastery) floored at 100, Dual base x1 floored at 100, Reversed base x1.4. DAMAGE: Light x(0.5 + 0.04*mastery), Balanced x(1 + 0.02*mastery), Heavy/Dual/Reversed x1.4. So Light = long reach / low damage and Heavy = short reach / high damage, with mastery moving the weak axis. The ANDROID v0.682 numbers the packet ported (x1.5 and 0.005*mastery) are a different tuning.
